caption_fb:
The village is often still there.

The church where they were baptized. The cemetery where their parents rest. Sometimes the same bell.

Even if only a few houses remain, standing there can mean more than any document.

Going Back to Poland is our guide to planning that trip: a day-by-day route built around the one day in the village, the parish office, the cemetery, the relatives, and 51 Polish phrases on cards you can carry.
